description: This file contains the Api class for interacting with Confluence's REST API, including methods for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting pages, as well as handling attachments and errors.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Provides methods to communicate with Confluence's REST API, including page retrieval, creation, updates, and attachment handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Api class with base URL, username, and password.

methods.name: setSpace
methods.description: Sets the space identifier for subsequent API calls.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a configured Guzzle HTTP client instance.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Processes BadResponseExceptions to provide more detailed error messages, including special handling for duplicate title errors.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Retrieves a page by its ID, including title, space key, ancestors, version, and content.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of pages under a specified root page, optionally recursively fetching child pages.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Creates a new page as a child of a specified parent page.

methods.name: updatePage
methods.description: Updates an existing page with new content and version number.

methods.name: showSourceCode
methods.description: Displays a snippet of source code with line highlighting and a caret for a specific column.

methods.name: deletePage
methods.description: Deletes a page by its ID.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Fetches information about an attachment associated with a page.

methods.name: putAttachment
methods.description: Uploads or updates an attachment file for a page.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of an attachment in bytes.

methods.name: uploadAttachment
methods.description: Uploads an attachment to a page, skipping if an identical one exists.
